changes.to: Maker release (2025-12-29 launch event) announces SYNDA R1 as the industry's first humanoid built to industrial-grade standards, with a full-size humanoid design, high-precision manipulation, all-weather continuous operation and adaptation to complex environments, plus a self-developed joint module line launched alongside. The release carries the specification table only as an image, so no height, weight, DOF, payload, speed or battery figure could be read from a maker source and every spec field is left empty. STEP (新时达, Shanghai STEP Electric, 002527) is an industrial robot and motion-control company; the humanoid line targets its own manufacturing scenarios first.
SYNDA R1 is Shanghai STEP Electric's first industrial-grade embodied humanoid, launched in December 2025 as a full-size bipedal-style platform for factory work.
